summary_md: **XiaoDong ([@haishenling](https://x.com/haishenling/status/2116775213975154840))** highlights **pixelfx**, an open library of pixel-art game effects each written as a small piece of code, with a Claude Code skill for generating new ones on request ([patch-gg/pixelfx](https://github.com/patch-gg/pixelfx)).

referenced_urls.title: GitHub - patch-gg/pixelfx: 232 pixel art effects, every one a small piece of code. Plus a Claude Code skill to make your own.

media.description: Chinese promo card for pixelfx: 244 pixel-art game effects, each a small code snippet, with a Claude Code skill; created Oct 30, about 1,600 stars in two days, MIT licensed.

来源 · GitHub 10-30
像素特效爆了 Claude代画
244个像素特效，个个都是一小段代码。
配个Claude Code技能：你说句话，它替你画新的。

■ 10月30日建仓，两天涨1600星
■ 244个像素游戏特效，开箱即用
■ Claude Code技能：说句话就画新特效
■ MIT协议，商用随便拿
■ GitHub热榜AI工具类新上榜
